acceptance: The stable package exports ChangeIntentV1, ProposedGraphDeltaV1, a closed operation vocabulary, deterministic validation/compilation, and stable typed errors without provider or persistence coupling.
A no-op intent compiles to a proposal whose candidate revision equals the validated base revision, whose delta contains no graph mutation, and whose proposal/delta identity is deterministic.

An upsert-node intent can add a valid new node or replace the attributes of an existing node of the same kind, and rejects a kind change, duplicate target, malformed node, or domain-invalid candidate with stable typed errors/issues.
Every proposal preserves the exact base revision, intent reference and digest, source provenance, confidence, and candidate revision; missing, out-of-range, or contradictory metadata fails closed.
Compilation does not mutate, reorder, or normalize the input document; results are deterministic across node/edge/JSON-key insertion order and repeated execution.

Candidate ProductGraphStateV1 passes the existing structural and domain validators, while canonical ProductGraphRevisionV1 identity remains unchanged for the base input and candidate identity is separately bound to the proposal.

Focused tests plus the full repository format, lint, typecheck, and test suites pass on the exact candidate; Diffcipline, Alibaba OCR, Jev, exact-head CI, and post-merge CI are recorded before closure.

required: Exact candidate and merge SHAs with base/head/merge-base and full changed-file accounting.
Focused compiler tests proving no-op/upsert behavior, fail-closed metadata/domain errors, deterministic digests, ordering independence, and input immutability.
Pinned Diffcipline proof, Alibaba OCR v1.12.7 accounting/delegation semantic review, Jev exact-diff judgments, and exact-head Ubuntu/Windows CI.
Post-merge fresh-main CI and canonical CURRENT/task frontier reconciliation.

minimality.rationale: Extend the already-qualified stable @ineractive/product-graph package with one small deterministic contract/compiler slice; no new package, dependency, provider, framework, or persistence abstraction is needed for this first vertical.

requirements: The compiler is pure and deterministic: no network, model inference, wall-clock/randomness dependence, source mutation, database, capability, or external effect.
Confidence is bounded numeric evidence only and never grants authority; provenance is mandatory and cannot be fabricated by the compiler.
Base revision identity, graph identity, operation targets, and candidate structural/domain validity are checked before a proposal is returned.
A proposal is not a canonical revision: callers must separately review/accept it, and this Grain cannot perform the later Question Gate or commit/source mutation.

outcome: The stable @ineractive/product-graph package accepts a bounded deterministic ChangeIntent and emits a validated ProposedGraphDelta plus candidate ProductGraphRevision for a no-op or one node upsert, with mandatory provenance/confidence and no canonical or source mutation.
rationale: IN-P02-S03-T01 is the next dependency-eligible P02 handle. This first Grain provides a small executable vertical slice before natural-language parsing, edge operations, Question Gate, or model integration can be added safely.

risk.recovery: Revert the SG-000027 change-intent/delta module, exports, focused tests, evidence, and frontier record; the existing Product Graph contracts and SG-000020 through SG-000026 domain semantics remain intact, and no canonical or source state is mutated.

scope_in: Define a stable ChangeIntentV1 envelope with an intent identity, exact base ProductGraphRevision, bounded user/source provenance, confidence, and a closed operation set containing no-op and upsert-node.

Define a stable ProposedGraphDeltaV1 envelope with proposal identity, base revision, intent reference/digest, typed operations, provenance/confidence, deterministic delta digest, candidate ProductGraphRevision, and validation issues.

Implement deterministic compilation of no-op and one-node upsert intents against a validated ProductGraphRevisionDocumentV1, including add, same-kind attribute replacement, duplicate-operation rejection, kind-change rejection, and domain validation of the candidate.

Export the contracts and compiler from @ineractive/product-graph and add focused tests for accepted and rejected cases, ordering independence, input immutability, and canonical/candidate digest behavior.
Record the Grain shaping, exact candidate evidence, and the next dependent frontier without claiming natural-language parsing or later P02-S04/P02-S05 completion.
scope_out: No natural-language or model/provider parsing, no edge add/remove/update operations, no delete or bulk graph operation, no Question Gate, Assumption Ledger, source binding, graph view, compiler, database, migration, network, credential, capability, or external-effect execution.
No mutation of canonical ProductGraphRevision input, source tree, database, Git state, or external system; a candidate revision is an in-memory proposal only.
No new workspace package, runtime dependency, lockfile change, framework adapter, or provider-paid inference.
No semantic changes to the already-qualified domain vocabularies, validators, persistence representation, or canonical JSON identity.
No claim that the full IN-P02-S03-T01 handle is closed; later Grains must cover richer operations and intent interpretation.
